content.text: When Stripe and other conventional payment platforms fail [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-what-actually-how-2|Tron USDT]]-what-actually-how|digital]] creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and other regions, they're left with no choice but to navigate the complexities of alternative infrastructure, such as Supabase, GitHub Pages, and Cloudflare Workers. This guide is for those who refuse to be locked out of the global market and instead, choose to build their own sovereign digital store with automatic [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-first-principles-definitive|COREMERCH guide to crypto]] payment verification.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The problem with conventional payment platforms is that they're designed to extract maximum revenue from digital creators while limiting their autonomy. In contrast, the infrastructure outlined in this guide empowers creators to own their data, configure their own payment pipelines, and scale their operations without relying on third-party vendors. By leveraging Supabase as the order database, GitHub Pages for hosting, and Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, creators can build a digital store that's fully sovereign and immune to platform restrictions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, you'll need to sign up for a Supabase account, create a GitHub Pages site, and configure your Cloudflare Workers project. You'll also need to set up a NOWPayments account to enable automatic crypto payment verification. Once you have these components in place, you can start building your digital store using the Sovereign Blueprint and deploying it using the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes 48 hours of end-to-end testing and handoff.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to configure your NOWPayments account to work with your Supabase order database and GitHub Pages hosting. This involves setting up a webhook to trigger payment confirmation and order fulfillment. You'll also need to configure your Cloudflare Workers project to handle payment requests and deliver digital products to customers. With the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), this process is streamlined and automated, ensuring that your digital store is live and processing transactions in no time.
By leveraging Supabase as your order database, you can scale your digital store to handle increased traffic and transaction volume.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, you can go live with your digital store and start processing transactions. With the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you'll have access to 30 days of support and end-to-end testing to ensure that your store is running smoothly. When you receive your first transaction, you'll be able to track it in real-time using the Supabase dashboard and verify payment confirmation through the NOWPayments interface.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your digital store grows and scales, you'll need to ensure that your infrastructure can keep up. With the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you'll have access to ongoing support and maintenance to ensure that your store remains live and functional. You'll also be able to leverage the scalability of Supabase and Cloudflare Workers to handle increased traffic and transaction volume, allowing you to focus on growing your business and creating more value for your customers.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The most important question to ask is: How can I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments without relying on Stripe or other conventional payment platforms? The answer is simple: by leveraging the infrastructure outlined in this guide, including Supabase, GitHub Pages, and Cloudflare Workers, you can build a fully sovereign digital store that's immune to platform restrictions and empowered to scale your business.
With the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you'll have access to 30 days of support and maintenance to ensure that your store remains live and functional.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your digital store using this guide, follow these steps: Sign up for a Supabase account and create a GitHub Pages site. Configure your Cloudflare Workers project and set up a NOWPayments account. Deploy your digital store using the Sovereign Blueprint and Edge Commerce Stack ($197). Configure your payment and delivery pipeline using the Edge Commerce Stack ($197). Go live with your digital store and start processing transactions.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up a Supabase order database?

To set up a Supabase order database, follow these steps: Sign up for a Supabase account and create a new project. Configure your database schema to work with your digital store's requirements. Deploy your database to Supabase and test it for functionality.
What is the difference between GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages?

GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are both hosting solutions that allow you to deploy static websites. However, Cloudflare Pages offers more advanced features and scalability, making it a better choice for larger digital stores.
Can I use NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification?
Yes, NOWPayments offers automatic crypto payment verification through its webhook integration. To set up this integration, follow the instructions in the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) documentation.
How do I configure my Cloudflare Workers project?

To configure your Cloudflare Workers project, follow these steps: Create a new project in the Cloudflare dashboard. Configure your workers to handle payment requests and deliver digital products to customers. Deploy your workers to Cloudflare and test them for functionality.
What is the Edge Commerce Stack ($197)?

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a fully functional digital store solution that includes 48 hours of end-to-end testing and handoff. With this stack, you'll be able to deploy a digital store with automatic crypto payment verification in no time.
By configuring your payment and delivery pipeline using the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you'll be able to automate your digital store's operations and focus on growing your business.
